concerns.text: The plan references the `TrainingRun` and `GatingSignal` schemas but does not explicitly mention the `EpisodeMetrics` and `ComparisonReport` entities defined in `data-model.md`. Adding clear references (e.g., “EpisodeMetrics will be persisted for bootstrapping analysis” and “ComparisonReport will be generated in Phase 4”) will align the plan with the full data model and ensure all entities have a designated usage.
